name: Jahaziel
bio: Jahaziel was a Levite descended from Asaph. When a massive coalition of Moabites, Ammonites, and Meunites marched against Judah and King Jehoshaphat led the people in fasting and prayer at the temple, the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel in the middle of the assembly. He declared that Judah need not be afraid, for the battle was not theirs but God's: they should take their positions the next day and watch the LORD win the victory without having to fight at all. His word proved true — the invading armies destroyed each other in confusion, leaving Judah only to gather the plunder (2 Chronicles 20:14-17).
